categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P; modifies network address key serialization used in peer address relay tracking across Tor and I2P.
categories.rationale: Prevents theoretical address key collisions across different networks in per-peer known-address bloom filters. The author notes that without network IDs in CService::GetKey(), 'in theory it would be possible for two I2P and Tor addresses to have the same output' causing a node to mistakenly suppress relaying an address, but this is an edge-case correctness issue rather than an active exploit or widespread failure.
